title: Landscape of adenosine to inosine RNA recoding across human tissues
description:
RNA editing by adenosine deaminases changes the information encoded in the mRNA

from its genomic blueprint. Editing of protein-coding sequences can introduce novel,

functionally distinct, protein isoforms and diversify the proteome. Here we sequenced blood samples of matched RNA and DNA from three healthy human donors. This was used to verify bona fide RNA editing sites.
